entry.name: locationName
entry.label: Empty until a place is chosen in the settings; the wallpaper shows a calm sky meanwhile.

entry.name: landscape
entry.label: The land drawn under the sky: one of KINDS in code/land.mjs, none, hills, city, sea, poppies, lake or village.

entry.name: landscapeHeight
entry.label: How much of the height of the screen the landscape takes, in percent.

entry.name: animations
entry.label: full, reduced or off; off is a still picture.

entry.name: pauseWhenCovered
entry.label: Whether the animation stops while a window is maximized or full screen on the screen of the wallpaper.
